corrected_content.problem:
Using the method of substitution, find the solution of

$$
\displaystyle \left\{\begin{aligned}-7a + 2b &=18 \\ \phantom{-}6a + 6b &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$
corrected_content.worked_solution: The second equation gives $b=-a$. Substitute into the first equation: $$-7a+2(-a)=18\implies-9a=18\implies a=-2.$$ Then $b=2$. Indeed, $-7(-2)+2(2)=18$ and $6(-2)+6(2)=0$.
